dataset: PMLR three-paper development corpus; agent-authored annotation draft
protocol: Same paper-specific corpus, parser, 1400-character chunks and k for all retrievers. No generation calls.

metrics.evidence_recall: annotated quote plus source-region center present in a top-k chunk
metrics.bound_cell_recall: correct parsed row label, leaf header, required parent group, value and source cell region in a top-k chunk

limitations: Development data used while improving the parser, not a held-out benchmark. Only three related computer-vision papers from one publisher; 12 facts paired across languages. Annotations need independent human review. Evidence recall is not answer accuracy or semantic support. Unanswerable probe candidate counts do not measure hallucinations or abstention.
